key: HYPNO: Noh...?
en: HYPNO: Noh...?
ja: スリーパー: ノォ……?

key: Noooooh...
en: Noooooh...
ja: ノォォォォ……

key: LUNA: \PN!
en: LUNA: \PN!
ja: ルナ: \PN!

key: LUNA: Oh, thank goodness. You've finally come to.
en: LUNA: Oh, thank goodness. You've finally come to.
ja: ルナ: ああ、よかった。ようやくお目覚めになられましたね。

key: You've been trapped within a dream,
en: You've been trapped within a dream,
ja: あなたは夢の中に囚われておいででした。

key: Perhaps an enviable state under other circumstances, but not so for one this foul.
en: Perhaps an enviable state under other circumstances, but not so for one this foul.
ja: 別の状況でしたら羨ましいことかもしれませんが、これほど不吉なものでは、そうも言えませんわ。

key: Never fear. I've come for you, as always I will.
en: Never fear. I've come for you, as always I will.
ja: ご心配なく。わたくしが参りましたわ、いつものように。

key: Please follow me.
en: Please follow me.
ja: どうぞ、ついてきてくださいませ。

key: The way will be long, but I swear to you I will see you out of here safely.
en: The way will be long, but I swear to you I will see you out of here safely.
ja: 道のりは長いでしょうが、必ずやここから無事にお連れすると誓いますわ。

key: LUNA: The enemy has been reaching out for you evermore.
en: LUNA: The enemy has been reaching out for you evermore.
ja: ルナ: 敵は、いっそうあなたに手を伸ばしてきておりますの。

key: There is no need to worry though; I've shielded you with my own power.
en: There is no need to worry though; I've shielded you with my own power.
ja: ですがご心配なさらず。わたくし自身の力で、あなたをお守りしておりますわ。

key: We should make haste, but so long as we stay this path, no harm will come to you.
en: We should make haste, but so long as we stay this path, no harm will come to you.
ja: 急ぐべきではありますが、この道を進んでいる限り、あなたに害は及びません。

key: LUNA: It is rather tiresome to journey all this way, is it not?
en: LUNA: It is rather tiresome to journey all this way, is it not?
ja: ルナ: ここまで旅をするのは、なかなか骨が折れますわね?

key: You have my apologies.
en: You have my apologies.
ja: 申し訳ございません。

key: A faster method would put us within the enemy's sights, and I would not jeopardize you as such.
en: A faster method would put us within the enemy's sights, and I would not jeopardize you as such.
ja: もっと速い方法では敵の目に留まってしまいますし、そのような危険にあなたをさらすわけにはまいりません。

key: Let us proceed.
en: Let us proceed.
ja: 参りましょう。

key: LUNA: Just a bit further now.
en: LUNA: Just a bit further now.
ja: ルナ: もう少しですわ。

key: I'll stay my pace with yours that we will not be separated.
en: I'll stay my pace with yours that we will not be separated.
ja: あなたと歩調を合わせて、はぐれないようにいたします。

key: LUNA: \PN?
en: LUNA: \PN?
ja: ルナ: \PN?

key: What ever is the matter?
en: What ever is the matter?
ja: 一体どうなさいましたの?

key: Could it be that you're afraid?
en: Could it be that you're afraid?
ja: もしや、恐れておいでですの?

key: Do you not trust me?
en: Do you not trust me?
ja: わたくしを信じてくださらないのですか?

key: Or...
en: Or...
ja: それとも……

key: LUNA: ...Did you notice already?
en: LUNA: ...Did you notice already?
ja: ルナ: ……もうお気づきでしたか。

key: SHIV: Boo.
en: SHIV: Boo.
ja: シヴ: わっ。

key: SHIV: Hah! I wish I could frame your face!
en: SHIV: Hah! I wish I could frame your face!
ja: シヴ: ハッ! 今の顔、額に入れて飾りたいくらいだよ!

key: It just gets better and better with you, doesn't it?
en: It just gets better and better with you, doesn't it?
ja: 君と来ると、どんどん面白くなっていくね。

key: Oh, what's the matter?
en: Oh, what's the matter?
ja: おや、どうしたんだい?

key: You look like you've seen a ghost.
en: You look like you've seen a ghost.
ja: 幽霊でも見たような顔をしてるじゃないか。

key: Or several, in fact.
en: Or several, in fact.
ja: いや、何体も見たような顔かな。

key: What is it? Are you surprised to see me again?
en: What is it? Are you surprised to see me again?
ja: どうしたの? また会えて驚いたかい?

key: I can't believe you really thought you were free...
en: I can't believe you really thought you were free...
ja: 君が本気で自由になったと思ってたなんて、信じられないよ……

key: After all, I wouldn't dismiss such a peculiar Trainer without properly testing your limits.
en: After all, I wouldn't dismiss such a peculiar Trainer without properly testing your limits.
ja: 何しろ、こんなに変わったトレーナーを、限界までちゃんと試しもせずに手放すわけがないだろう。

key: Come on...
en: Come on...
ja: さあ……

key: Every step you've made through this dream has been of my desire.
en: Every step you've made through this dream has been of my desire.
ja: この夢の中で君が踏んだ一歩一歩、すべて僕の望み通りだったんだよ。

key: Did you really think my apology was sincere?
en: Did you really think my apology was sincere?
ja: 僕の謝罪が本気だったと、本当に思ってたのかい?

key: Oh, please.
en: Oh, please.
ja: やめてくれよ。

key: You subjected yourself to this when you entered into my world.
en: You subjected yourself to this when you entered into my world.
ja: 僕の世界に足を踏み入れた時点で、君は自らこれを招いたんだ。

key: Did you notice that you didn't even really get a Darkrai?
en: Did you notice that you didn't even really get a Darkrai?
ja: 本当はダークライなんて手に入れてすらいなかったって、気づいてたかい?

key: You... like so many others... are so easily fooled.
en: You... like so many others... are so easily fooled.
ja: 君も……他の大勢と同じように……本当に簡単にだまされるんだね。

key: It's all just part of the dream...
en: It's all just part of the dream...
ja: これは全部、夢の一部にすぎない……

key: And you have yet to wake up.
en: And you have yet to wake up.
ja: そして君はまだ、目を覚ましていない。

key: However... you're different...
en: However... you're different...
ja: だけど……君は違う……

key: And you continue to surprise me.
en: And you continue to surprise me.
ja: 僕を驚かせ続けてくれる。

key: Watching you stumble your way through this nightmare has been quite inspiring, really.
en: Watching you stumble your way through this nightmare has been quite inspiring, really.
ja: この悪夢の中を、つまずきながら進んでいく君を見るのは、本当に見応えがあったよ。

key: You don't seem to give up, do you?
en: You don't seem to give up, do you?
ja: 君は諦めないみたいだね?

key: No matter how far I warp and deform your memories into this world...
en: No matter how far I warp and deform your memories into this world...
ja: どれだけ君の記憶をこの世界にゆがめて作り変えても……

key: You keep pulling through.
en: You keep pulling through.
ja: 君は乗り越え続ける。

key: You would have been perfect for what we needed...
en: You would have been perfect for what we needed...
ja: 僕たちが必要としていたものに、君はぴったりだったはずなのに……

key: But my master doesn't make errors, and you're certainly not the Trainer that was promised.
en: But my master doesn't make errors, and you're certainly not the Trainer that was promised.
ja: でも僕の主は間違えない。そして君は、確かに約束されたトレーナーではない。

key: In fact, your being here is an enigma in itself.
en: In fact, your being here is an enigma in itself.
ja: 実際、君がここにいること自体が謎なんだよ。

key: Fine, Trainer...
en: Fine, Trainer...
ja: いいだろう、トレーナー……

key: I've had my fun.
en: I've had my fun.
ja: もう十分楽しませてもらった。

key: I'm done toying with you.
en: I'm done toying with you.
ja: 君をもてあそぶのはこれで終わりだ。

key: I've neglected my true work long enough.
en: I've neglected my true work long enough.
ja: 本来の仕事を怠るのも、もう十分だからね。

key: So then... where does that leave you?
en: So then... where does that leave you?
ja: それで……君はどうなると思う?

key: However... I can't leave my curiosity about you unquenched...
en: However... I can't leave my curiosity about you unquenched...
ja: だが……君への好奇心を満たさないままにはしておけない……

key: In fact... I only have one more test for you.
en: In fact... I only have one more test for you.
ja: 実のところ……君にはあと一つだけ、試練が残っている。

key: One last deal.
en: One last deal.
ja: 最後の取引だ。

key: No more tricks...
en: No more tricks...
ja: もう小細工はなしだ……

key: No more dreams...
en: No more dreams...
ja: もう夢もなしだ……

key: I want you to battle me, \PN.
en: I want you to battle me, \PN.
ja: 僕とバトルしてもらうよ、\PN。

key: One last time, here and now.
en: One last time, here and now.
ja: 最後にもう一度、今ここで。

key: You defeat me, and you can return to your real world.
en: You defeat me, and you can return to your real world.
ja: 僕を倒せば、君は現実の世界に戻れる。

key: Fail to do so, and I'll leave you here, in this nightmare.
en: Fail to do so, and I'll leave you here, in this nightmare.
ja: できなければ、この悪夢の中に君を置き去りにする。

key: The choice is yours.
en: The choice is yours.
ja: 選ぶのは君だ。

key: Although... as usual, you don't really have one, do you?
en: Although... as usual, you don't really have one, do you?
ja: もっとも……いつも通り、選択の余地なんてないんだけどね?

key: So... let's have our final dance, shall we?
en: So... let's have our final dance, shall we?
ja: さあ……最後のダンスといこうじゃないか。

key: With my dreams, my tricks, cast aside... you must think you stand a chance.
en: With my dreams, my tricks, cast aside... you must think you stand a chance.
ja: 僕の夢も小細工も脇に置いたところで……君は勝機があると思ってるんだろうね。

key: But this is still my world, \PN.
en: But this is still my world, \PN.
ja: でも、ここはまだ僕の世界なんだよ、\PN。

key: ...And your nightmare.
en: ...And your nightmare.
ja: ……そして君の悪夢だ。

key: It seems that my hypothesis was correct after all...
en: It seems that my hypothesis was correct after all...
ja: やはり、僕の仮説は正しかったようだね……

key: SHIV: That was... well, quite fascinating.
en: SHIV: That was... well, quite fascinating.
ja: シヴ: それは……なかなか、興味深かったよ。

key: It would appear that you had more control over this dream than I realized.
en: It would appear that you had more control over this dream than I realized.
ja: 僕が思っていたより、君はこの夢を制御できていたみたいだ。

key: You truly are an anomaly, \PN.
en: You truly are an anomaly, \PN.
ja: 君は本当に、異常な存在だね、\PN。

key: You almost make me question my master's judgment...
en: You almost make me question my master's judgment...
ja: 主の判断を疑いたくなるくらいだよ……

key: As, if you aren't the Trainer we've been searching for...
en: As, if you aren't the Trainer we've been searching for...
ja: もし君が、僕たちが探しているトレーナーじゃないとしたら……

key: Then who is?
en: Then who is?
ja: じゃあ、一体誰なんだ?

key: Whatever the case... all good things must come to an end.
en: Whatever the case... all good things must come to an end.
ja: いずれにせよ……良いことにも終わりはあるものだ。

key: I like to think that, eventually, I am a man of my word.
en: I like to think that, eventually, I am a man of my word.
ja: 結局のところ、僕は約束を守る男でありたいと思ってる。

key: So, I suppose I'd best return you to your world, \PN.
en: So, I suppose I'd best return you to your world, \PN.
ja: だから、そろそろ君を君の世界に返した方がよさそうだね、\PN。

key: This time, I can tell you with certainty that you won't see me again.
en: This time, I can tell you with certainty that you won't see me again.
ja: 今度こそ、確かに言えるよ。もう二度と僕には会わない。

key: A bit of parting advice, before you go:
en: A bit of parting advice, before you go:
ja: 行く前に、はなむけ代わりの助言を一つ。

key: Seeing as how you handled yourself in that nightmare, and in our battle...
en: Seeing as how you handled yourself in that nightmare, and in our battle...
ja: あの悪夢の中での立ち回りと、僕たちの戦いを見た限り……

key: You mustn't be afraid to dream a little bigger, \PN.
en: You mustn't be afraid to dream a little bigger, \PN.
ja: もっと大きな夢を見ることを、恐れちゃいけないよ、\PN。

key: After all, dreaming big never hurt anyone, did it?
en: After all, dreaming big never hurt anyone, did it?
ja: だって、大きな夢を見て、誰かが傷ついたことなんてないだろう?

key: This world, when it comes down to it, can be molded into whatever you desire.
en: This world, when it comes down to it, can be molded into whatever you desire.
ja: 結局のところ、この世界は君の望む通りに形作れるものなんだ。

key: For once, it really is your choice.
en: For once, it really is your choice.
ja: 今回ばかりは、本当に君次第だよ。

key: But for now, it's time for you to wake up...
en: But for now, it's time for you to wake up...
ja: でも、とりあえず今は、目を覚ます時間だ……

key: The true dark master awaits not too far ahead still.
en: The true dark master awaits not too far ahead still.
ja: 本当の闇の主は、そう遠くない先で君を待っている。

key: Farewell, \PN.
en: Farewell, \PN.
ja: さらばだ、\PN。

key: DARKRAI: ...
en: DARKRAI: ...
ja: ダークライ: ……

key: Ri, ri...
en: Ri, ri...
ja: リ、リ……

key: DARKRAI: Krii!!
en: DARKRAI: Krii!!
ja: ダークライ: クリィ!!
